title: Excavations in Palestine, 1934-5: Balata
author: (round-up; expedition directed by E. Sellin and Steckeweh)
location_note: Tell Balata (Shechem), plot east of the acropolis; no map reference; placed by name.
notes: Sept.-Nov. 1934: Hellenistic and Persian houses (round-up calls both 'Iron Age'), a Middle Bronze Age house with amphorae and stone filters. No eligible feature.
